"Leptura" longipennis
is an
extinct
species of
longhorn beetle
that lived in the
Oligocene
of Germany. It was first described by
Georg Statz
in 1938, from a fossil of two
elytra
and a leg found in the
Rott Formation
. It was originally described as a species of the genus
Leptura
, but later research has determined it does not belong to that genus, and that it has an uncertain placement in the
Lepturinae
subfamily.
